fact: The Ministry of Health's Data Quality Improvement Plan reports that its 2020 HIS assessment, which covered 243 health facilities, found 70.4% of health facilities lacking a computer, tablet or internet, and sets a target of raising the proportion of health facilities with internet connectivity and a computer from 28.6% to 75%; it does not say how many facilities enter their own HMIS reports.
title: Data Quality Improvement Plan (DQIP) June 2022–2027
